name: BC817-25LT1G
title: NPN general-purpose transistors BC817-16L, -25L, -40L, SOT-23
summary: A family of NPN silicon small-signal transistors in the three-lead SOT-23 surface-mount package, rated 45 V collector to emitter and 500 mA continuous collector current. The -16, -25 and -40 suffixes are current-gain groups at 100 mA: 100 to 250, 160 to 400 and 250 to 600. Versions with an S or NSV prefix are AEC-Q101 qualified and PPAP capable. Dissipation is 225 mW on an FR-5 board and 300 mW on an alumina substrate at 25 °C.

operation.text: The -16, -25 and -40 types differ in their DC current gain range at IC = 100 mA, VCE = 1.0 V; the ratings and the minimum gain of 40 at 500 mA are common to all three. Their marking codes are 6A, 6B and 6C.
Part numbers starting S or NSV are for applications that need unique site and change control; they are AEC-Q101 qualified and PPAP capable.
All versions are lead-free, halogen-free and BFR-free, and meet RoHS.

Allowed dissipation depends on the mounting: 225 mW at 25 °C on an FR-5 board (556 °C/W junction to ambient, falling 1.8 mW per °C above 25 °C) and 300 mW on an alumina substrate (417 °C/W, 2.4 mW per °C).
Single-pulse boundaries at 25 °C ambient are given for 1 ms, 10 ms, 100 ms and 1 s, beside the thermal limit.
